name: Cevat
explanation: A lighthouse keeper of forty years. Says little, sees much.
content: For Cevat the lighthouse is not a duty but a vow. He believes that keeping one's word is possible even in the dark.

stories.title: The Last Keeper of the Lighthouse
stories.explanation: For years the lighthouse burned the same light — until one night it went out on its own.

stories.title: Forgotten Letters
stories.explanation: A chest full of letters becomes an invisible thread binding two strangers together.
